comment: Build tools the Windows build adds (lane B4c): LLVM clang-cl, nasm, pkgconf. They leave no code in the archives. Library sources, including the transitive ones, are pinned in ../versions.json and fetched by ../scripts/sources.py. Every download is SHA-256 verified before extraction.

llvm.note: clang-cl compiler; compiler-rt is not linked (MSVC CRT /MD)

libffi-meson-port.note: meson build files for libffi from wrapdb (patch_hash of libffi_3.8.0-1); applied over the versions.json libffi source, no code of their own
